episode_notes: A Telugu comedy-drama web series episode centered on Prithvi, a 30-year-old bachelor, whose family tricks him into an arranged marriage with 21-year-old Meghana. The humor drives on their awkward 9-year generational gap and Prithvi's age anxiety, culminating in their first night where Meghana unexpectedly drops her quiet, polite act to aggressively roast him.
